# IT CPA & Advisory, PLLC

> CPA firm based in Missouri City, Texas (Houston area). We prepare individual and business tax returns and handle bookkeeping, payroll, business formation, IRS representation and tax planning for small business owners and individuals. Serves clients in all 50 states. Service in English and Vietnamese (Tiếng Việt).

## Firm facts
- Legal name: IT CPA & Advisory, PLLC
- Texas CPA firm license: C12382
- Location: Missouri City, TX 77459
- Principals: Ivy Truong, CPA (Founder) and Tony Hoang, EA (IRS Enrolled Agent)
- Languages: English and Vietnamese
- Clients: small business owners and individuals, including many Vietnamese-speaking small businesses such as nail salons, boba and milk tea shops, and restaurants
- Secure client portal: https://itcpa-us.taxdome.com

## Services
- Entity formation and structuring: entity selection (LLC vs. S-corp), formation filings, EIN, state registration, operating agreements, initial tax planning
- Bookkeeping: transaction recording, account reconciliation, financial reporting, year-end close
- Payroll: payroll processing, payroll tax withholding and filing, direct deposit, year-end W-2s and 1099s
- Tax preparation: individual (Form 1040) and business returns, federal and state filing
- IRS representation: audits, IRS notices and correspondence, negotiation with the IRS, penalty abatement, tax debt relief, liens and levies
- Tax advisory: year-round personal and business tax planning

## Pricing: individual tax returns (Form 1040)
- Basic, $200 per return: one W-2, standard deduction
- Standard, $350 per return: one W-2, itemized deductions, additional forms as needed
- Premium, $500 per return: multiple W-2s, itemized deductions, additional forms as needed
